Service 01

Business & Technology Consulting.

Clear processes, clear goals

Overview

Before we build anything, we map how the business actually runs today: where process breaks down, where technology is doing too little or too much, and where growth is being left on the table. This is the audit-first foundation every other Zyvex Tech engagement is built on: a concrete, prioritized plan instead of a generic recommendation deck.

Ideal for

Founders and operators who know something in their process or stack isn't working, but need a clear, prioritized plan rather than more advice.

What’s included

  • Process & Funnel Audits
  • Technology Goal Setting
  • Systems & Workflow Design
  • Actionable Transformation Strategy
  • Efficiency Diagnostics

Is This You

Signs You Need Business & Technology Consulting.

Growth has stalled and it's unclear whether the bottleneck is process, tech, or team

You're paying for tools and platforms that don't talk to each other

Every new initiative gets improvised instead of following a repeatable process

You want a prioritized roadmap, not another generic strategy deck

How We Deliver It

The Process, Step by Step.

Step 01

Discovery & Stakeholder Interviews

We start by talking to the people actually running the business day to day, not just reading dashboards, to understand where time and money are really being lost.

Step 02

Process & Funnel Mapping

Every workflow, tool, and handoff gets mapped end to end, so bottlenecks and duplicated effort are visible instead of assumed.

Step 03

Prioritized Roadmap

Findings get translated into a ranked list of fixes, ordered by impact and effort, not by what's easiest to talk about.

Step 04

Implementation Handover

Where the roadmap points to a build (Shopify, automation, a new tool), we scope it directly into the relevant service, so the audit turns into action, not a shelved report.

FAQ

Common Questions About Business & Technology Consulting.

Do you only audit, or do you also implement the fixes?

Both. The audit is the foundation, but nothing in it goes on a shelf. Findings hand directly into whichever service (Shopify build, automation, CRO) actually solves them.

How long does a typical audit take?

Most process and funnel audits take one to two weeks depending on how many systems and stakeholders are involved, followed by a working session to walk through the prioritized roadmap.

We already have a tech stack. Do you replace it or work with it?

We work with what's already delivering value and replace only what's genuinely holding growth back. The goal is a system that fits how you operate, not a rebuild for its own sake.
